summaryBox.title: 10 NEST Traps
summaryBox.takeaway: Kjeldahl fails for pyridine/nitro; Gauche conformer more stable with H-bonding; Carbanion stability CH₃⁻>1°>2°>3°; Steam distillation boils <100°C; Lassaigne N+S gives blood-red [Fe(SCN)]²⁺.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST TRAPS SUMMARY

1. Kjeldahl fails for Pyridine, Nitro, Azo compounds (use Dumas).
2. Gauche conformer of ethylene glycol is more stable than anti due to H-bonding.
3. Carbanion stability is reversed: CH₃⁻ > 1° > 2° > 3°.
4. Heat of Hydrogenation (HoH) is inversely proportional to alkene stability.
5. Steam distillation boils BELOW 100°C.
6. Lassaigne test for N and S together yields BLOOD-RED [Fe(SCN)]²⁺ (no Prussian blue).
7. Canonical resonance structures are hypothetical; real molecule is the Resonance Hybrid.
8. Hyperconjugation involves σ_C-H delocalization (No-Bond Resonance).
9. Carbocations readily rearrange via 1,2-hydride or 1,2-methyl shifts.
10. EtBr-stained DNA is visible strictly under UV radiation (not white light).
